resources.basis: Seven fixed-nuisance likelihood evaluations and restored baseline per completed fit; no optimization at this stage.

interpretation: Full realigned cohort: evaluate seven multipliers of the saved longest-normalized-dS branch t parameter with all nuisance parameters fixed. Baseline likelihood restored per case. Not an optimized profile or dS confidence interval; nuisance reoptimization, identifiability, saturation and selection eligibility remain unresolved.
